comment: A design for tools/ui-scripts/drawing-standard.mitcad-ui (mitcad#2047): a 40 x 30 x 20 block (F2.b0) and Drawing1 (D1, A3, the ISO template, ISO dimensioning) with its front view at 1:1 (the block 80,110 to 120,130 on the sheet) and a vertical dimension between the front's bottom and top edges: 20, written along its line (90 degrees) under ISO.
